sentences.text: Lina Modak @ Roy vs State Of West Bengal & Ors on 20
January, 2023

Author: Rajasekhar Mantha
Bench: Rajasekhar Mantha
20-01-2023 ct no. 13 Item No. 1(Sl) pk Wpa 1760 of 2023

Lina Modak @ Roy
-Versus-
State of West Bengal & Ors.

Mr. Moyukh Mukherjee, Mr. Pritam Roy, Mr. Koustav Lal Mukherjee, Mr. Soewel Bhattacharjee
...for the petitioner Notice was served in the morning after leave was granted by this Court on
extreme urgency cited by the counsel for the petitioner.
The matter was taken up at 2 p.m. after due notice was served on the Bidhannagar East Police Station and the office of the Government Pleader.

A further notice was issued to the investigating officer of the case by the counsel for the petitioner on the direction of this Court after 2 p.m. to be present before this Court at 3.30 p.m. Neither the I.O. nor the O.C., Bidhannagar East Police Station are represented before this Court.

It appears that the petitioner's husband and two other persons were running a start-up business of facilitating admission to any candidate, who qualified in the NEET Examination, into medical colleges.
They have been picked up on a suo motu complaint of the S.I. Sudipta Naskar, Bidhannagar East Police Station and arrested against a G.D. No.1099 dated 17.01.2023 at 5.13 p.m.

Thereafter, FIR came to be registered on the same day at 6.40 p.m. under Sections 188, 419, 420, 408, 409, 471,
120B of the IPC and Sections 20 and 21 of the Telegraph Act.
The maximum punishment in each of the aforesaid sections is below seven years.

In terms of the decisions of the Supreme Court in the case of Arnesh Kumar Vs. State of Bihar and Anr. reported in (2014) 8 SCC 273 and Rini Johar and Anr. Vs. State of Madhya Pradesh and Ors. reported in (2016)
11 SCC 703, notice under Section 41A is mandatory.

sentences.text: It is submitted that the petitioner does not have any student under their company as yet.
No sums whatsoever have been collected from any student.
This Court is inclined to grant interim bail.
No notice under Section 41A of the Cr.P.C. has been issued to the petitioner and what is most surprising is that arrest was made even before registration of the FIR.

sentences.text: In the above circumstances, let Subhojit Roy, son of Baidyanath Roy, Shaiket Chowdhury, son of Swapan Chowdhury and Rimpa Ghosh, daughter of Meghnath Ghosh, detained by the Bidhannagar East Police Station, be released interim bail on condition that they shall not leave the jurisdiction of the Bidhannagar East Police Station until further orders of this Court.

The said persons shall be present in Court on 24th January, 2023 when the matter shall be taken up marked "To be Mentioned".
Let notice of this order be served upon the O.C., Bidhannagar East Police Station.
All parties shall act on the server copy of this order duly downloaded from the official website of this Court.

(Rajasekhar Mantha, J.)
